Nevron_JarNeedLight.name: Jar's Light
Nevron_JarNeedLight.summary: Inside the cave between Grand Meadow and Indigo Tree. Jar asks you to bring him light.

Nevron_DemineurMissingMine.name: Demineur Missing Mine
Nevron_DemineurMissingMine.summary: At the northern shipwreck area. The pale Demineur asks for an intact mine.

Nevron_SmallBourgeon.name: Small Bourgeon
Nevron_SmallBourgeon.summary: In the overworld cave between Flying Waters and Red Woods. Bring it a Bourgeon Skin so it can grow.

Nevron_PortierDoorMaze.name: Portier Spirit
Nevron_PortierDoorMaze.summary: Beyond the maze in Esoteric Ruins. Help the spirit find the item it is looking for.

Nevron_WeaponlessChalier.name: Chalier Help
Nevron_WeaponlessChalier.summary: Inside the Floating Cemetery. Chalier asks which weapon it should wield.

Nevron_Benisseur.name: Benisseur Fountain
Nevron_Benisseur.summary: At the fountain in Red Woods. It asks for Chroma.

Nevron_Hexga.name: Hexga Crystals
Nevron_Hexga.summary: On the main-story path through Stone Wave Cliffs. Hexga asks for lustrous rock crystals.

Nevron_Troubadour.name: Troubadour Help
Nevron_Troubadour.summary: In Stone Quarry on the way to Monoco's Station. Let the green notes hit you and dodge the red ones.

Nevron_DanseuseDanceClass.name: Danseuse Teacher
Nevron_DanseuseDanceClass.summary: Deep in Frozen Hearts past Glacial Falls. Follow the tracks and jump down to find the Nevron.

Nevron_JudgeOfMercy.name: Judge of Mercy
Nevron_JudgeOfMercy.summary: Speak to Blanche in The Fountain. Her judgment depends on how you handled the other Nevrons.
